tasks.title: Add pending→deleted (cancel) transition + invalid-transition sentinel to the state machine
tasks.dod: state machine allows pending→deleted and rejects every non-pending source with a sentinel error; unit tests cover each end state.

tasks.title: Add findActivePendingOrdered() to the ReminderRepository port
tasks.dod: port interface declares findActivePendingOrdered() returning pending reminders ordered by fire time; compiles, no behavior change to existing callers.

tasks.title: Implement findActivePendingOrdered in SqliteReminderRepository (reuse idx_reminders_state_scheduled_at)
tasks.dod: repo returns pending rows ordered by scheduled_at asc, tie-broken by capture order, using the existing index; integration test with a fixed clock passes.

tasks.title: ListActiveReminders use-case — build the view model with truncation + overflow
tasks.dod: use-case returns an ordered view model (bounded ~100-char preview per row); empty set → empty view model; overflow → soonest-fitting rows + count not shown (ADR-0003); unit tests cover empty / normal / overflow.

tasks.title: CancelPendingReminder use-case — guard pending, transition, persist
tasks.dod: use-case loads by id, applies pending→deleted and persists on success, surfaces the sentinel unchanged for any non-pending state; unit tests cover success + every stale end state.

tasks.title: /list command handler — render the single Active-list message (+ empty message)
tasks.dod: handler sends exactly one message: rows with per-row cancel/source buttons, fire time in the Owner's /settings tz, or the no-active-reminders message when empty; owner gate (existing auth middleware) rejects non-Owner; send-count=1 integration test passes.

tasks.title: Cancel + go-to-source callback handlers (uniform no-op; deep-link/inline fallback)
tasks.dod: cancel callback confirms in a separate message on success and shows the uniform "no longer active" no-op otherwise; source callback reuses the fired-reminder deep-link/inline fallback rule; owner gate on callbacks; unit tests cover confirm / no-op / both source branches.

tasks.title: Wire /list — register command, command-menu entry, callback routes + DI
tasks.dod: router registers /list and the Telegram command-menu entry behind the owner gate and wires the cancel/source callbacks; both entry points produce the same response; router-auth test covers the owner gate on the new routes.
